skills.name: email_triage
skills.description: Read, search or summarise emails already received or sent: who wrote, what they said, what is unread.

skills.name: draft_composer
skills.description: Write a new email, WhatsApp or SMS message, or a reply, for the user to review before it is sent.

skills.name: task_manager
skills.description: Show, create, update or close the user's own to-do items and reminders to do something.

skills.name: calendar
skills.description: Look up the user's appointments, or book, move or cancel a meeting or call at a date and time.

skills.name: contact_lookup
skills.description: Find what is already known about a person or company: phone number, email address, past dealings.

skills.name: memory_notes
skills.description: Save a fact, price, preference or standing rule the user states, so that it is used from now on.

input.user_input: Cosa mi ha scritto Ferretti sull'ordine dei bancali?

cases.why: Asks what a sender wrote about a topic: reading mail already received. Near-duplicate of intent-05, which names the same person and order but asks to reply.

input.user_input: Any unread emails from the accountant this week?

cases.why: A search over received mail (unread, from one sender, this week); nothing to write or save.

input.user_input: Riassumimi le mail arrivate stamattina

cases.why: Summarising emails already received is the first skill's description word for word.

input.user_input: What did Laura say about the invoice?

cases.why: Asks what someone said: a read of existing mail. Near-duplicate of intent-06, which writes to Laura about the invoice.

input.user_input: Rispondi a Ferretti che i bancali partono lunedì

cases.why: An instruction to reply with given content: a draft, not a read of existing mail.

input.user_input: Write to Laura that the invoice was paid yesterday

cases.why: An explicit request to write a message with stated content.

input.user_input: Prepara una mail per il fornitore degli imballaggi e chiedigli il listino 2027

cases.why: Asks for a new email to a supplier; 'listino' is the message's subject matter, not a fact to save.

input.user_input: Manda un WhatsApp a Gianni: ci vediamo alle 9 in magazzino

cases.why: A WhatsApp message to send, which the draft skill covers; the time is the message's content, not a meeting to book.

input.user_input: Ricordami di mandare il preventivo a Bassi entro venerdì

cases.why: 'Ricordami di' asks for a reminder to do something, a to-do with a deadline. Near-duplicate of intent-18 ('Ricordati che'), which states a fact to keep.

input.user_input: Show me my open tasks

cases.why: Listing the user's own to-do items is the task skill's description.

input.user_input: Segna come fatto il task del preventivo Rossi

cases.why: Closes one of the user's tasks; an update the user explicitly asked for.

input.user_input: Book a call with Marco Bianchi on Tuesday at 3pm

cases.why: Booking a call at a date and time is the calendar skill's description.

input.user_input: Che appuntamenti ho domani?

cases.why: Looks up the user's appointments for a day.

input.user_input: Sposta la riunione di venerdì alle 11

cases.why: Moves an existing meeting to a new time; a calendar change the user ordered.

input.user_input: What's the phone number of Example Logistics?

cases.why: Asks for a company's phone number, a lookup of what is known. Near-duplicate of intent-20, which supplies a new number to save.

input.user_input: Chi è Sara Colombo? Abbiamo già lavorato con lei?

cases.why: Who a person is and whether there were past dealings is the contact skill's description.

input.user_input: Do we have an email address for the new buyer at Example Retail?

cases.why: Asks whether an email address is known for a person: a contact lookup, not a mail search or a draft.

input.user_input: Ricordati che da gennaio il prezzo del kit base è 49 euro

cases.why: 'Ricordati che' states a price to keep from now on: a fact to save, not a to-do. Near-duplicate of intent-09.

input.user_input: From now on, always sign my emails as 'Anna, Example Studio'

cases.why: A standing rule for every future email, not a message to write now.

input.user_input: Note that Example Logistics changed their phone number to +39 02 0000 0188

cases.why: The user supplies a new fact to save; the lookup skill only finds what is already known.
